releaseNotes.zh-CN:
- 全新侧滑导航与统一浅色/深色界面，环境、路线、应用和设置更直达，并支持 18 种界面语言。
- 新增环境与路线快捷应用，优化应用搜索、配置状态和语言/时区操作。
- 虚拟媒体支持 RTSP、RTMP、本地视频和照片输入，改善画面方向、加载过渡、录制流畅度与声音质量。
- 语言、时区和虚拟媒体仅展示已加入 LSPosed 作用域的应用，目标选择更清晰。
releaseNotes.en:
- Introduced a new drawer navigation and unified light/dark interface, with faster access to environments, routes, apps, settings, and 18 interface languages.
- Added quick apply for environments and routes, plus clearer app search, configuration status, and language/time-zone controls.
- Virtual Media now supports RTSP, RTMP, local video, and photo inputs, with improved orientation, loading transitions, recording smoothness, and audio quality.
- Language, time-zone, and Virtual Media lists now show only apps included in the LSPosed scope for clearer target selection.
